---

### **Step 4: Final Model**

**Objective:**

$$
\text{Maximize } Z = 2500x + 1500y
$$

**Subject to:**

$$
\begin{align*}
x + y &\leq 110 & \text{(Total hours ≤ 110)} \\
x &\geq 70 & \text{(Curtain fabric sales requirement)} \\
y &\geq 45 & \text{(Clothing fabric sales requirement)} \\
x, y &\geq 0 & \text{(Non-negativity)}
\end{align*}

---

$$

\begin{aligned}
&\text{Maximize } Z = 2500x + 1500y \\
&\text{Subject to:} \\
&x + y \leq 110 \\
&x \geq 70 \\
